subject: Web Development
title: Performance Budgets
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Performance Budgets.

hook.text: Without limits, websites grow heavier every sprint. New features add kilobytes quietly.

buildup.text: A performance budget sets hard limits: no more than 200 KB of JavaScript, for example.

discovery.text: Teams with budgets catch regressions before users do. The budget becomes a quality gate.

twist.text: Most teams set budgets once and then ignore them under deadline pressure.

climax.text: The teams that enforce budgets ship faster sites year after year. Discipline beats talent.

quiz.question: What does a performance budget limit?
